note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Oman: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Oman levies no income tax on individuals in 2026; the Personal Income Tax Law of Royal Decree 56/2025 takes effect on 1 January 2028, at 5% of taxable income above an annual threshold of OMR 42,000.
figures.applies: From 1 January 2028 for residents (citizens and expatriates) on worldwide income; the 2028 brackets read the threshold as an exempt first band, per PwC and Deloitte.

المادة (٨) تستحق الضريبة بمعدل (٥٪) خمسة في المائة من الدخل الخاضع للضريبة
Neither residents nor nonresidents are subject to income or capital gains taxes in Oman.
An annual income threshold of 42,000 Omani rial (OMR) has been set, above which a 5% tax rate will apply.

figures.finding: An Omani employee pays 8% and the employer 14.5% to social security (retirement on pay up to OMR 3,000 a month); for a non-Omani employee only the employer pays, 3%.
figures.applies: 2026. A self-employed or performers' scheme was not found.

sources.said: Social security contributions for Omani employees are at a total of 22.5% (14.5% by the employer and 8% by the employee).

figures.finding: No income tax is withheld from pay in 2026; from 2028 the employer must withhold the new tax from salaries.

sources.said: An employer must withhold and pay any tax due on their employees’ salaries, wages, member's remuneration, and pensions periodically.
Neither residents nor nonresidents are subject to income or capital gains taxes in Oman.

figures.finding: A non-resident individual owes no income tax in Oman, but a 10% withholding tax is taken from royalties and technical or management service fees paid to non-residents, wherever the service is performed.
figures.applies: Deloitte's table applies the 10% to non-resident individuals; PwC writes it of foreign companies. Whether a performance fee counts as a service fee was not found.

sources.said: Royalties 0% 0% 10% 10%
A 10% withholding tax is imposed on technical service fees paid to nonresidents, regardless of the place of performance of the services.
Foreign companies that do not have a PE in Oman for tax purposes and that derive income from Oman in the nature of the following are subject to WHT at 10% of gross income from such sources

figures.finding: VAT is 5% (Royal Decree 121/2020, from 16 April 2021); registration is mandatory above OMR 38,500 of annual supplies and voluntary above OMR 19,250.

sources.said: There is a mandatory registration requirement if the total value of annual supplies exceeds or is expected to exceed OMR 38,500.
The standard rate of VAT in Oman is 5%

figures.finding: From 2028 the tax year is to be followed by an electronic return within six months of its end; no individual return exists for 2026.
figures.applies: Calendar tax year assumed from the law's 1 January commencement; due date applies from 2028.

sources.said: Tax returns have to be filed electronically, within six months from the end of the tax year.
